people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
translations.bsb: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
translations.kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are ➔ not afraid with any amazement.
translations.asv: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
